spec.name: Orange Kitchen Vegetable Tempura
spec.description: Golden cucumber batons and an ivory-centered onion ring nestle in a shallow folded paper tray beside a warm ceramic dipping pot. Stepped batter clusters give the morsels a crisp, irregular silhouette; exposed green cucumber and onion layers identify the ingredients.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Vegetable Tempura. Several irregular crispy breaded morsels in a shallow paper tray; small dipping sauce pot. Actual recipe ingredients: batter, cucumber, onion. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
